comment: Which fragments make which defconfig (IMPLEMENTATION.md E.4). tools/defconfig.py merges each
target's fragments in order, later wins only on a line marked '# override:', and writes
configs/<target>_defconfig. A fragment name without a slash is configs/fragments/<name>.fragment;
one with a slash is a path under linux/. kind: tier (a userland with its GPU packs) or hw (a
family's hardware pack, built against the SDK of the tier named by sdk_from). publish: true marks
a target linux/build.sh --publish may build; such a target must be a release (decision I37).
pending_paths: files the fragments name that later steps write; a missing one is reported, not
failed, and linux/build.sh refuses a target that needs one until it exists.

pending_paths.board/common/rootfs-overlay-dev: G2e (init): the dev overlay this step's dev.fragment adds, with the serial getty
